svg.title: The inspection aperture faces the trace
svg.desc: Make the mechanical aperture attend to a transcript strip while answer cards recede. This directional change should read as research into observation, not an omniscient eye watching the agents.

**Action:** Attention shifts from solving the task to understanding the observer.

**Caption:**
